name: Harvard In Tech - Numbers Band On An iPad
description: The homepage at 768px (iPad portrait), scrolled to the numbers band. Since the October 2026 all-hands the band carries six figures, and one row of six would push the page sideways ("10,000+" alone is ~180px), so between 761px and 1200px it wraps to two rows of three and the page stays inside the screen. The hover only scrolls the band into view, since a URL fragment does not scroll a capture.
